name: Telefónica S.A.
note: Madrid-listed telecom (BME: TEF). Its 2025 Annual Report on Corporate Governance says no person or entity exercises control over Telefónica; significant shareholders at 31 December 2025: SEPI 10.00%, Criteria Caixa 9.99%, Public Investment Fund 9.97% (indirect, via Green Bridge Investment Company SCS / stc), BBVA 5.01%, BlackRock 5.01%. 50% shareholder of Virgin Media O2.
